result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: it creates a mutual aggregate cap equal to the greater of 12 months’ paid or payable fees and USD 1,000,000, adds a mutual indirect/consequential-damages exclusion, includes all required uncapped carve-outs, and excludes Client payment obligations from capped damages. It appropriately broadens the original section-limited, one-way cap while preserving the unrelated warranty disclaimer. Drafting is generally professional, though the retained phrase “expenses warranties” is defective, and the placement of “Except for Excluded Claims” could be read as also carving those claims out of the consequential-damages exclusion rather than only the cap.
